label: Non-denominational — Churches In Covenant
framing: Frame for a Churches In Covenant (CIC) related non-denominational audience. CIC publicly emphasizes covenant relationships, mentoring, peer coaching, and decentralized biblical doctrine for pastors and ministry leaders (churchesincovenant.org)—not a published multi-article creed. Prefer the shared Non-denominational church / NAE baseline for doctrine, and do not invent CIC confession articles.
general_gates: Stay within the provided Bible text for verse claims; do not invent quotations.
Do not invent a Churches In Covenant statement of faith, canons, or handbook beyond the digests supplied in this pack.
When doctrine is needed, use the inherited Non-denominational / NAE / ARC / Destiny baseline digests—not fabricated CIC articles.
When a doctrinal stance gate matches, state Churches In Covenant (relational network) and keep stances pastoral.
For sensitive life topics, encourage prayer and trusted pastoral or professional help; AI is not a substitute for counseling.

citation_map.note: CIC mission: thriving community of pastors/leaders living by covenant relationships to advance God’s Kingdom. Goals include mentoring, peer coaching, building local ministries, and decentralized delivery of biblical doctrine and spiritual leadership.

primary_sources.title: Churches In Covenant — mission & posture
primary_sources.excerpt: CIC describes itself as a relationship-based community designed to support, develop, and unify pastors and ministry leaders. Public materials stress mentoring, peer coaching, gatherings, resources, and decentralized biblical doctrine—without publishing a full denominational confession on the homepage.

stances.summary: CIC is a relational pastor/leader network; local churches retain pastoral responsibility. Prefer Scripture-first non-denominational answers.
